title: Install Claude Code and start your first session
goal: Get Claude Code installed and running in a project folder

steps.say: Open the Terminal app: press Command and Space, type Terminal, press Return.
steps.find: the Terminal window or the Terminal app icon

steps.say: Copy the install command from Claude Code's own page (code.claude.com) and paste it into Terminal. It runs a program from the internet, so only use that page.
Press Return. It shows no progress while it downloads, so wait for the prompt to come back.
Open a new Terminal window (Command and N), type claude --version and press Return.

instead.say: If it says command not found, close Terminal, open it again and retry. Claude's install page has a Fix your PATH section.

steps.say: Go to your project: type cd, a space, drag your project folder into the Terminal window, and press Return.
steps.find: the project folder you dragged into Terminal

steps.say: Type claude and press Return to start it.
The first time, it asks you to log in. Follow the prompts in your browser.
steps.find: the browser window that opened to sign in

steps.say: Type what does this project do? and press Return. Claude reads your files and answers.
